_comment: Anna Executa descriptor for the gamentic engine. The comms layer is app/executa.py (stdio JSON-RPC bridge over the unchanged FastAPI app). `anna-app dev` discovers this and spawns `command` (cwd = this dir); `anna-app executa publish` reads slug/name/version/distribution and mints the real tool_id.
name: Gamentic
description: Gamentic game engine, exposed as an Anna Executa. One tool, `request`, replays an HTTP-style call against the engine.

distribution._comment: active=uv: ONE py3-none-any wheel on PyPI works on every platform. The Agent runs `uv tool install <package_name>==<version>` (it ALWAYS appends ==version), so package_name MUST be the PyPI distribution name, NOT a wheel URL (uv rejects `<url>==<ver>` - the URL has to end in .whl). The PyPI name == [project].name == executable_name == tool_id. uv fetches a managed CPython + the platform dep wheels (deps carry wheels up to the newest CPython uv may pick), then launches the `executable_name` console script. Publish the wheel to PyPI at the SAME version before publishing this executa. `local` is the dev-harness path. Install on the Agent via More -> Agents -> Install Essentials.
